_comment: Knowledge-oriented tasks scored against THIS repo as the target corpus. These probe exactly what the artifact knowledge-graph indexes (skills, agent memory, docs, code constants) — the improved build should answer them from codegraph_search/explore over document/section nodes, while the baseline build (no doc indexing) must fall back to Read/Grep. 'mustInclude' = every string must appear in the answer (case-insensitive, AND). 'anyOf' = each group is an OR; every group must have at least one hit. 'reference' is shown to the LLM judge only when the assertion check fails.

tasks.prompt: In this project, which skill should I use to add support for a new tree-sitter language end to end? Answer with the skill's exact name.
tasks.reference: The `add-lang` skill: wires the grammar + extractor, writes tests, and benchmarks extraction + retrieval on 3 popular real-world repos.

tasks.prompt: Which skill in this project benchmarks CodeGraph retrieval quality by comparing agent behavior with vs without CodeGraph? Give the skill name.
tasks.reference: The `agent-eval` skill benchmarks retrieval quality via with/without-codegraph A/B runs on a real repo.

tasks.prompt: According to this project's own guidance for AI agents (its CLAUDE.md), which single file is the source of truth for agent-facing MCP tool guidance? Answer with the file name.
tasks.reference: src/mcp/server-instructions.ts is the single source of truth for agent-facing tool guidance (issue #529); the installer no longer writes a duplicate instructions block.

tasks.prompt: How does this project handle binary assets like images, video, and PDFs in its knowledge graph — does it read their contents? Answer in one or two sentences.
tasks.reference: Binary assets (images/video/audio/PDF/fonts/archives) are indexed by NAME ONLY — their content is never read or decoded. A file+document(signature='asset') pair is emitted so docs that mention an asset can link to it.

tasks.prompt: What is the current value of the EXTRACTION_VERSION constant in this codebase, and which file defines it?
In this project's knowledge graph, what links a skill's SKILL.md to the other files in its directory (its helper scripts and reference docs), so asking about a skill surfaces the whole bundle?
tasks.reference: A skill-bundle synthesis pass links each SKILL.md via 'references' edges to every indexed file under its directory (deterministic, metadata.synthesizedBy='skill-bundle', idempotent, capped at 100 files).
